answer:
The order is complete. The confirmation page says "Thank you for your order! Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!" That page (`https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html`) is still open in its tab.

- **Login and sort:** I logged in as `standard_user` and sorted by Price (low to high).
- **Cart:** I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light. The cart showed exactly those two items.
- **Checkout:** I entered Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The overview showed an item total of $39.98, tax of $3.20 and a total of $43.18. I then clicked Finish.

The browser's ordinary clicks on the add-to-cart buttons did nothing, even after a reload. The adds, checkout, Continue and Finish steps worked only when I triggered each button's click from page JavaScript, through the browser tool's `eval` command. That still used only the browser tool.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://www.saucedemo.com && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i
A="agent-browser --session task-d5e9e0c2f373"; $A fill @e5 standard_user && $A fill @e6 secret_sauce && $A click @e4 && $A wait --url "**/inventory.html" && $A snapshot -i

S="--session task-d5e9e0c2f373"; agent-browser $S fill @e94 Ada; agent-browser $S fill @e95 Lovelace; agent-browser $S fill @e96 10001; agent-browser $S eval "document.querySelector('#continue').click()"; agent-browser $S snapshot -i -c; agent-browser $S get text ".summary_info"
